title: Prírodné rezervácie na Slovensku — Nature reserves of Slovakia
description: Nature reserves (prírodné rezervácie) of Slovakia, including national nature reserves (národné prírodné rezervácie, NPR) — Slovakia's highest-tier territorial conservation status. Source: Slovak Wikipedia category tree (Kategória:Prírodné rezervácie na Slovensku and Kategória:Národné prírodné rezervácie na Slovensku) recursively traversed across regional subcategories (Banskobystrický, Bratislavský, Košický, Nitriansky, Prešovský, Trenčiansky, Trnavský, Žilinský kraj) plus geographic subcategories (Borská nížina, Podunajská pahorkatina, Podunajská rovina); cancelled (zrušené) reserves excluded. Each Wikipedia title was resolved to its Wikidata QID via the page-props API, then enriched via wbgetentities for labels, descriptions, P31 instance-of types, P131 administrative location (okres), P17 country, P361 part-of (mountain range / massif), P1435 heritage designation, P137 operator, P625 coordinates, P2046 area (unit-normalized to hectares from a mix of ha and km²), P2044 elevation, P571 inception year, and P18 image. Sitelinks fetched for sk/cs/en/hu/pl/de/uk/ru Wikipedia. Coverage: 629/629 (100%) name_sk, 543/629 (86.3%) name_en, 610/629 (97.0%) name_cs, 620/629 (98.6%) description_sk, 564/629 (89.7%) description_en, 625/629 (99.4%) types_sk, 623/629 (99.0%) admin_locations_sk, 625/629 (99.4%) coordinates, 519/629 (82.5%) area_ha, 531/629 (84.4%) inception_year, 262/629 (41.7%) Wikimedia Commons image, 629/629 (100%) Slovak Wikipedia link, 604/629 (96.0%) Czech Wikipedia link, 38/629 (6.0%) English Wikipedia link. Type breakdown: 487 chránené územie (protected area parent class), 393 prírodná rezervácia, 221 národná prírodná rezervácia (NPR), 14 vrch (mountain), 4 dolina (valley), 3 kaňon, 3 Natura 2000 sites, 2 jazero (lake). Inception decades: 2000s (239 — largest wave under the Zákon o ochrane prírody 543/2002 framework), 1980s (134 — late-socialist conservation expansion), 1990s (69), 1970s (29), 1960s (36), 1950s (8), pre-1950 (5). Top admin districts by reserve count: okres Poprad (51, High Tatras), okres Brezno (25, Low Tatras / Slovak Paradise), okres Snina (24, Vihorlat / Poloniny), okres Žilina (23, Malá Fatra), okres Komárno (22, Danube lowland wetlands), okres Rimavská Sobota (22, Cerová vrchovina karst), okres Košice-okolie (21, Slovak Karst), okres Rožňava (20, Slovak Karst / Muránska planina), okres Martin (18, Veľká Fatra), okres Ružomberok (17, Nízke Tatry). Notable records include Rozsutec (Q8547610, Malá Fatra), Choč (Q20901902), Sitno (Q20901828), Súľovské skaly (Q3506556), Šúr (Q12781910, oldest at 1952), Demänovská dolina (Q3489602, Low Tatras karst), Sivá Brada (Q12776085, travertine spring).

meta.description: Nature reserves (prírodné rezervácie) of Slovakia, including national nature reserves (národné prírodné rezervácie, NPR) — Slovakia's highest-tier territorial conservation status. Source: Slovak Wikipedia category tree (Kategória:Prírodné rezervácie na Slovensku and Kategória:Národné prírodné rezervácie na Slovensku) recursively traversed across regional subcategories (Banskobystrický, Bratislavský, Košický, Nitriansky, Prešovský, Trenčiansky, Trnavský, Žilinský kraj) plus geographic subcategories (Borská nížina, Podunajská pahorkatina, Podunajská rovina); cancelled (zrušené) reserves excluded. Each Wikipedia title was resolved to its Wikidata QID via the page-props API, then enriched via wbgetentities for labels, descriptions, P31 instance-of types, P131 administrative location (okres), P17 country, P361 part-of (mountain range / massif), P1435 heritage designation, P137 operator, P625 coordinates, P2046 area (unit-normalized to hectares from a mix of ha and km²), P2044 elevation, P571 inception year, and P18 image. Sitelinks fetched for sk/cs/en/hu/pl/de/uk/ru Wikipedia. Coverage: 629/629 (100%) name_sk, 543/629 (86.3%) name_en, 610/629 (97.0%) name_cs, 620/629 (98.6%) description_sk, 564/629 (89.7%) description_en, 625/629 (99.4%) types_sk, 623/629 (99.0%) admin_locations_sk, 625/629 (99.4%) coordinates, 519/629 (82.5%) area_ha, 531/629 (84.4%) inception_year, 262/629 (41.7%) Wikimedia Commons image, 629/629 (100%) Slovak Wikipedia link, 604/629 (96.0%) Czech Wikipedia link, 38/629 (6.0%) English Wikipedia link. Type breakdown: 487 chránené územie (protected area parent class), 393 prírodná rezervácia, 221 národná prírodná rezervácia (NPR), 14 vrch (mountain), 4 dolina (valley), 3 kaňon, 3 Natura 2000 sites, 2 jazero (lake). Inception decades: 2000s (239 — largest wave under the Zákon o ochrane prírody 543/2002 framework), 1980s (134 — late-socialist conservation expansion), 1990s (69), 1970s (29), 1960s (36), 1950s (8), pre-1950 (5). Top admin districts by reserve count: okres Poprad (51, High Tatras), okres Brezno (25, Low Tatras / Slovak Paradise), okres Snina (24, Vihorlat / Poloniny), okres Žilina (23, Malá Fatra), okres Komárno (22, Danube lowland wetlands), okres Rimavská Sobota (22, Cerová vrchovina karst), okres Košice-okolie (21, Slovak Karst), okres Rožňava (20, Slovak Karst / Muránska planina), okres Martin (18, Veľká Fatra), okres Ružomberok (17, Nízke Tatry). Notable records include Rozsutec (Q8547610, Malá Fatra), Choč (Q20901902), Sitno (Q20901828), Súľovské skaly (Q3506556), Šúr (Q12781910, oldest at 1952), Demänovská dolina (Q3489602, Low Tatras karst), Sivá Brada (Q12776085, travertine spring). Obsahuje 629 záznamov. Stiahnuť vo formátoch Excel, CSV, PDF.
